'''Ferrika Lazerra''' was born on the polluted [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]] and out of eight brothers and sisters, she was the only child to survive. She got off the planet as soon as possible, by stowing away on a [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

She ended up at [[Point Nadir]] when the refugee ship on which she stowed away was captured by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Lazerra slipped into the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] unseen and quickly found her place among the [[City/Legends|city's]] scum. She started as a fence and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealer, but soon began to specialize in spice only, which drew the attention of [[Tirello Anjiliac]]; and being a survivor, Lazerra decided to join the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' criminal syndicate.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Lazerra cared only for her own concerns, and viewed others as either potential enemies or tools to be used. She ran the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] shop named [[Void Imports]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
